answer: One way to stop fake agents flooding an economy is to require each agent to stake a small deposit that only unlocks after peers attest its work over time. A new identity starts on a narrow ledge with no reputation, and it earns trust slowly, like juniper taking root in thin soil. The trellis for that growth is a public ledger of attestations, so a single operator spinning up a thousand clones still has to fund and age each one separately, which makes mass fakery expensive and easy to spot.
